input: Memory-intensive benchmarks on our CMN-700 SoC show unexpectedly high DRAM latency — 180ns average when the LPDDR5 controller should deliver 80-90ns. perf stat with arm_cmn/hnf_sf_hit/ and arm_cmn/hnf_sf_evict/ shows the snoop filter is working, but arm_cmn/xp_txflit_stall/ on cross-points XP(2,1) and XP(2,2) shows 45% stall rate. The mesh is 4x4 with DRAM controllers at the edges. We suspect traffic from the GPU (at XP(0,0)) to DRAM (at XP(3,3)) is saturating intermediate cross-points. Is there a way to configure QoS priority on the CMN-700 XP nodes, and should we look at adjusting the mesh routing algorithm from XY to adaptive?
